cohort: Stable newborn infants >=35 weeks gestation admitted to a well-baby nursery, excluding those with respiratory distress, congenital infections, malformations, or syndromes.
finding: Healthy term newborns had a mean troponin-I level of 0.019 ± 0.018 ng/mL, which was significantly lower than the elevated levels (0.081 ± 0.1 ng/mL) found in asymptomatic neonates born to mothers with a history of SARS-CoV-2 during pregnancy.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in troponin-I levels between infants born by vaginal birth versus cesarean section.
